conditions: Visible attribution to TradingView with a link to https://www.tradingview.com/ on every page that shows a chart (the licence NOTICE asks for it): the chart's attributionLogo stays on and the renderer footer names TradingView Lightweight Charts
Keep the NOTICE file when redistributing the bundle
Load it only behind the module's load() so Studios without charts don't pay for it
reasons: Canvas renderer built for large time-ordered series: lines, candles and histograms in one pane, about 45 kB gzipped
No runtime dependencies; actively maintained by TradingView (v5 in 2025, series markers and panes as plugins)
Exposes time <-> pixel conversion and click events, which is what span / instant annotation tools need
Apache-2.0 is compatible with a proprietary product; the only extra condition is the attribution

alternatives.note: Used for the `spec` renderer (any chart from a JSON spec), too slow for large interactive series
Broader but heavier (~300 kB) and its time-axis interaction is less direct
